summary: Frontend-only test of 'Carga al furgón' (CargaLista.jsx) on mobile 390x844 with driver 1122/1122. Verified 'Posición' comes from saca_session.position (Ordenar Sacas) and NOT from parada order. Walked all 5 cards; the mapping matched expected exactly: parada 5→pos 1 (ES010004), 4→2 (ES085201), 3→3 (ES090544), 2→4 (ES053275), 1→5 (ES063644). Sacas/bultos also matched per order. Devolver reduced progress 5/5→4/5, and 'No tengo más capacidad' appeared. Confirm modal was NOT clicked to preserve seeded data per instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: CargaLista.jsx: division by zero risk when total=0 in progress bar width (currently guarded by early return of empty state, OK).

CargaLista.jsx L23: fallback posicion=null renders '—'; consider explicit warning toast when saca_session positions are missing for stops in driver_route to surface data inconsistencies to the driver.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded data for driver 1122 (position!=parada).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Posición in CargaLista is correctly sourced from GET /api/my/sacas session.positions joined by stop_id, distinct from parada (order in driver_route). Full walkthrough validated the mapping and sacas/bultos values. The 'carga-confirm-ok' path was intentionally left untested to avoid truncating the seeded driver_route.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — the reported concern (Posición mirroring Parada) was only a symptom of prior test data where the two happened to coincide. With seeded data where position != parada, the UI correctly shows different values, confirming posByStop mapping works as designed.
